newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian group to launch new wool fabric.
newsitem.headline: Australian group to launch new wool fabric.

text.p: An unlisted Australian public company said it is making a bid to revitalise the wool industry through a new yarn which eliminates the prickle factor and will be aimed to crack non-traditional markets.
Pinnacle Wool Enterprises Ltd, presently owned by about 20 wool producers and raising capital to begin operations, sees a market for the new yarn in sportswear and furnishing fabric.

Medium 19-25 micron category wool, which is in far greater supply and cheaper than superfine wool, will be used to provide a yarn which produces a temperature control effect by absorbing 30 percent of its own weight in moisture which evaporates
through cool down, Pinnacle said in a statement.
Other features of the yarn are fire retardant qualities and machine washability without shrinking or loss of shape, it said.
Pinnacle will bid to revolutionise the value added wool market, with golf targeted as a leading sport market, it said.
Asked if Pinnacle planned to list on the Australian Stock Exchange, Murray Armstrong, a principal of Pinnacle Wool, declined direct comment but indicated it was under consideration.
Pinnacle is presently raising A$1 million to begin commercial operations through strategic alliances with fabric makers in specialist areas.
